newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light hand-to-mouth buying.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light hand-to-mouth buying.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw light nearby demand as consumers covered their immediate needs, market sources said.
"We saw some hand-to-mouth buying this afternoon in the back of easier seller prices coupled to a weaker dollar, but all in all the market remained dull," one broker said.

Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $287 a tonne fob Rotterdam. Arrived Brazilian soymeal pellets changed hands at $304 a tonne fob Ghent and afloat at $297 and $297 cif Rotterdam from two vessels.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
